body:
admin_login.go's login page now uses the same IDUNA cream/gold ceremony aesthetic (Cormorant Garamond + Spectral) as the notebook portal login, with eye-of-providence-robot as hero art, served via /portal/images/. Cross-linked with /portal/login. Designed via /design canvas 'IDUNA Back Office Login' (clean + error states) first, then ported into the live template. go build/go test clean. Commit f394094.

⚓ ☃
title: Restyled IDUNA Back Office login to match the portal's cream/gold style guide + Prompt-o-verse art
